title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedules & Room Allotment Published
author: Controller of Examinations
description: Mid-Semester assessments for Semester 3, 5, and 7 commence from October 14, 2026. Hall tickets and seating allotments are accessible via the portal.

title: Elective Course Add/Drop Window Final Deadline Notice
author: Academic Registrar
description: The online course change and elective finalization portal will close strictly on September 28, 2026 at 11:59 PM. Late petitions will incur administrative penalty.

title: Merit Scholarship Applications Open for Academic Year 2026-27
author: Student Welfare Board
description: Applications are invited from eligible students with CGPA >= 8.5 for University Merit and Need-cum-Merit tuition fee waiver scholarships.

title: Campus Library Extended Hours During Mid-Term Preparation
author: Chief Librarian
description: The Central Reference Library and digital learning wing will remain open 24/7 beginning October 1 through October 25 to support study sessions.

title: National Technical Symposium Call for Papers & Project Posters
author: R&D Research Committee
description: Undergraduate researchers are encouraged to submit 4-page IEEE formatted manuscripts or project posters on applied artificial intelligence and networks.

title: Holiday Announcement: Gandhi Jayanti & University Recess
author: Registrar General
description: University academic blocks, administrative desks, and regular classes shall remain suspended on October 2, 2026 on account of Gandhi Jayanti.

title: Compulsory 75% Attendance Compliance Rule Reminder
author: Dean Academic Affairs
description: Students with aggregate attendance below 75% across individual theory and laboratory subjects will be debarred from sitting for the end-term evaluations.

title: Hostel Fee Payment & Room Re-Allotment Guidelines
author: Chief Warden Office
description: Hostelites must clear second installment mess and amenity payments by October 5 to retain current dormitory allocations.

title: Campus Placement Drive 2026: Pre-Placement Talk by Global Tech
author: Head of Corporate Relations
description: Pre-Placement briefing and online aptitude screening for Semester 7 students for Software Engineer and Data Analyst associate roles.

title: Annual Sports Meet Team Trials & Registration Schedule
author: Director of Sports
description: Selection trials for university football, basketball, badminton, and track athletic squads will take place between September 25 and September 30.
